observations: Photo 0 shows a closed silver laptop with an Apple logo on the lid, resting on a glass display table; cables and a power adapter are visible underneath.
Photo 1 shows the thin side profile of the same silver laptop with ports along the edge.

Photo 2 is a screenshot of 'About This Mac' showing 'MacBook Pro', '2.3 GHz 8-Core Intel Core i9', '32 GB 2667 MHz DDR4' memory, '1 TB' storage, '16-inch (3072 x 1920)' display, serial number C02GC0AYMD6T, and 'macOS Tahoe Version 26.5'.

claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows MacBook Pro and 16-inch display but does not show the year 2019.
Photo 2 shows Memory: 32 GB 2667 MHz DDR4.
Photo 2 shows Storage: 1 TB (978.29 GB available of 1 TB).
Photo 2 shows Intel UHD Graphics 630 only; the dedicated AMD Radeon Pro 5500M is not visible.

risks.risk: The About This Mac screenshot shows 'macOS Tahoe Version 26.5', which does not exist, so the screenshot or operating system may be fabricated or tampered.
risks.proof: Video of the Mac booting to a genuine macOS desktop and showing a legitimate About This Mac window, or a screenshot of the serial number checked on Apple's coverage page.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a non-genuine or tampered system, not working

risks.risk: Battery health and cycle count are unknown; the battery could be dead or heavily degraded.
risks.proof: Screenshot of battery health/cycle count from System Report or a tool like CoconutBattery.
risks.if_unproven: priced as dead battery requiring replacement

risks.risk: The dedicated AMD Radeon Pro 5500M graphics are not verified and may be absent or faulty.
risks.proof: System Report graphics entry or video of the Mac running a graphics-intensive application.

risks.risk: The built-in display condition is not shown; it could have dead pixels, lines, or backlight damage.
risks.proof: Photo or video of the screen powered on showing the full display area.

risks.risk: Keyboard and Touch Bar functionality are unproven.
risks.proof: Video of all keys and the Touch Bar working.

risks.risk: Activation lock or Find My Mac status is unknown; the Mac could be locked to another account.
risks.proof: Video showing the Mac is not activation locked and Find My Mac is off.

proof_requests: Video of the MacBook Pro booting to the desktop and showing a genuine macOS About This Mac window
Screenshot of System Report showing memory, storage, graphics, and serial number
Photo of the screen powered on with no visible damage
Battery cycle count and health proof
Video confirming Find My Mac is off and there is no activation lock
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an Apple MacBook Pro 16-inch from the logo and system screenshot, but the operating system version shown is impossible and key specs are unproven, so it is priced at worst case pending proof.
